onboarding.start.title: Get started
onboarding.start.intro: Create your Arena 360 account. We'll text a code to your phone.
onboarding.field.name: Your name
onboarding.error.name: Enter your name, up to 80 characters.
onboarding.error.cafe_name: Enter your café's name, up to 80 characters.
onboarding.error.city: Enter your city, up to 80 characters.
onboarding.error.phone_in: Enter a 10-digit mobile number that starts with 6, 7, 8 or 9.
onboarding.error.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
onboarding.error.offline: Couldn't reach Arena 360. Check your connection and try again.
onboarding.error.rate_limited: Too many codes requested. Try again in {time}.
onboarding.code.title: Enter your code
onboarding.code.sent: We sent a 6-digit code to {phone}. It works for 5 minutes.
onboarding.code.label: 6-digit code
onboarding.code.invalid: That code isn't right. Check it and try again.
onboarding.code.expired: This code no longer works. Send a new code.
onboarding.code.resend_wait: Wait a moment before asking for a new code.
onboarding.code.resend_in: You can resend the code in {time}.
onboarding.code.resend_ready: You can resend the code now.
onboarding.sign_in.message: You already have an account. Sign in to continue.
onboarding.account_setup.title: Account setup
onboarding.password.title: Choose a password
onboarding.password.intro: You'll use this password with your phone number to sign in.
onboarding.password.label: Password
onboarding.password.hint: Use at least 10 characters. Very common passwords aren't allowed. You can paste one from a password manager.
onboarding.password.common: That password is too common. Choose another.
onboarding.totp.title: Set up your authenticator app
onboarding.totp.intro: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app, such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator. Then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
onboarding.totp.qr_alt: QR code for adding Arena 360 to your authenticator app. If you can't scan it, use the setup key instead.
onboarding.totp.key_help: Can't scan? Choose "Enter a setup key" in the app and type or paste this key.
onboarding.totp.invalid: That code didn't work. Enter the current code from your authenticator app.
onboarding.codes.title: Save your backup codes
onboarding.codes.intro: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once. Keep them somewhere safe. You won't see them again.
onboarding.codes.file_header: Arena 360 backup codes. Each code works once.
onboarding.codes.confirm_first: Tick the box once you've saved your codes.
onboarding.unacked.title: Get new backup codes
onboarding.unacked.intro: Your authenticator app is set up, but you didn't confirm saving your backup codes. They can't be shown again, so get a new set with a current code from your authenticator app.
onboarding.regenerate.invalid: That code didn't work. Wait for the next code in your authenticator app and enter it.
onboarding.done.title: Your account is ready
onboarding.copy_failed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it instead.
onboarding.security.title: Account security
onboarding.security.codes_body: Getting new backup codes replaces all of your old ones. You'll need a current code from your authenticator app.
onboarding.security.not_enrolled: Finish setting up your account first.
onboarding.security.dialog_intro: Enter the current code from your authenticator app.
onboarding.security.done: Your new backup codes are saved.
